thread:
Julia: Hi support — our Aug 22 invoice (INV-9933) shows zero usage for the 'transcribe' product, but our dashboard shows ~14,200,000 tokens for that day. The CSV export for 2024-08-22 that we downloaded has no rows for customer_id=CUST-918. Can someone take a quick look?

Maria: Thanks — can you paste the CSV header or a tiny snippet? makes triage faster.

Julia: Sure, here's the top of the file we downloaded:```csv
date,customer_id,model,tokens,region
2024-08-22,CUST-001,generate,12000,us-west-2
2024-08-22,CUST-002,embed,3400,us-east-1
# no CUST-918 rows present
```

Akash: Thanks. Two quick checks: are you certain the dashboard and invoice are both scoped to UTC dates? We had a shard edge-case that can drop the late-hour partition. Which timezone are you operating in?

Julia: We're in CET (UTC+1). The bulk of the traffic was around 23:40 CET (so 22:40 UTC) on Aug 22.

Maria: I'm going to try re-running the one-day export for that partition. @data-pipeline-bot please enqueue a targeted export for date=2024-08-22 only (shard by hour). Using the internal export tool so we can capture logs.

data-pipeline-bot: Job queued: job_id=job_20240822_73, target_date=2024-08-22, shards=[0..23], triggered_by=Maria

Akash: I pulled the job logs from job_20240822_73. There's a WARN in worker-7 around 2024-08-22T23:00:12Z:```text
WARN worker-7 sampler: sample-skip count=1 reason=padding-mismatch partition_hour=22 row_index=0
WARN worker-7 commit: commit-skipped partition_hour=22 reason=no-output-after-sampling
```
This looks like the row(s) for that hour were filtered by the sampling/de-dup optimization when padding_lt threshold was hit. That would explain a zero row export even though dashboard aggregated tokens.

Sam: I think I know this one — a recent sampler change (padding threshold) can drop single-row partitions when padding metadata is missing. I'll prepare a quick patch to avoid dropping partitions with any rows. Plan: revert the aggressive skip for single-row partitions and add a guard to the padding check. Deploy ETA ~2 hours.

Sam: After the patch I'll run a backfill for 2024-08-22 hour=22 (UTC) and then re-run the billing export for that date.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-9933 flagged: status=provisional_credit_pending. Suggested action: mark invoice provisional until backfill finishes.

Maria: :thumbsup: can we get an estimate total tokens affected so we can communicate to the customer?

Sam: From the dashboard snapshot I see ~14.2M tokens across the day; the missing hour looks to be ~1.8M tokens. I'll confirm exact count after the backfill run.

Julia: Can you also provide the exact repro steps and the minimal command we can run if we need to repro in a staging environment? We want to audit the logic on our side too.

Akash: Repro steps (minimal):
1) Checkout the export sampler branch (commit abc123) or use the CLI.
2) Run the targeted exporter with forced small-padding mode:```bash
# run on staging with a single-hour shard to reproduce the drop
redwood-exports --date 2024-08-22 --hours 22 --shard 7 --force-padding-threshold 0.1 --output ./out.csv
```
3) Observe the logs for a 'sample-skip' WARN. If patch applied, the WARN should no longer cause commit-skipped.

Akash: Note: the temporary mitigation is to re-run exports with --disable-sampler-de-dupe which will keep the rows intact while we roll the patch.

Julia: Perfect, thanks — that helps a lot. We'll wait for confirmation of the backfill and the regenerated CSV before updating our accounting. :pray:

Maria: I'll keep this thread updated. Setting case to INVESTIGATING and adding provisional invoice note.

Sam: Patch deployed and backfill started — job_id=backfill_20240822_hour22. I'll post the regenerated CSV once complete.

Julia: Great, thank you all.
